recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed unless Pharmacy later changes the modern CodeableReference medication pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-7995 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It requested CodeableConcept support in addition to a Medication reference for MedicationStatement, and the accepted resolution covered medicationPrescription, medicationStatement, medicationAdministration, and medicationDispense while identifying FHIR-7473 as the duplicate target.
initial_application: No current git commit message explicitly mentions FHIR-7995 or FHIR-7473. Jira comments say the work was already done, and 2015 medication spreadsheet history shows medicationCodeableConcept/code search support being added near medicationReference handling.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is now MedicationRequest. source/fhir.ini actively includes MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement. Current StructureDefinition XML uses CodeableReference with targetProfile Medication for each requested medication element. FHIR-38682 later restored the MedicationStatement name after the MedicationUsage rename and stated the resource scope had not changed.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already satisfies the accepted code-or-resource semantics through CodeableReference(Medication) on all four resources named in the resolution.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-7995 says it was approved as a duplicate of FHIR-7473, which has the same accepted resolution.
Restored MedicationStatement after the MedicationUsage rename and confirmed the scope had not changed.
